name: Little Gods of the Abyss
description:
About This Game

[About Game]
The world's rifts began at the 'Primal Gate'. And now, the journey of the last being capable of purifying that gate begins.

《Little Gods of the Abyss》 is a 3D platformer adventure game set in a corrupted world. The player becomes Nia, a little god with the special ability to mend and restore gates, embarking on a journey across a ruined and twisted world to purify the Primal Gate.

The world is already covered in rifts. Life has stopped, emotions are twisted, and space has lost its original form. Passing through silent forests, lifeless ruins, and geometrically distorted places, the player does not simply move forward, but directly experiences how broken the world has become.

Nia's journey is not a simple exploration. It is a process of reversing the severed flow, reopening closed gates, and restoring the lost balance. And at the center of it all lies the power of music that will set this world in motion again. During the journey, the player gathers healing stars filled with music to activate closed gates and advance deeper toward the Primal Gate.

In a world that is beautiful yet unsettling, quiet yet unfamiliar, the narrative—conveyed through symbols and atmosphere rather than words—stimulates the player's senses and imagination, leaving a lasting resonance.

When the gate closes, the world stops. Now, with the last hope, Nia, head toward the truth beyond the abyss.


[Game Features]

Nia, the Little Being Who Heals Gates

Become a special being capable of mending and restoring gates, and restore the ruined world.

Smooth 3D Platformer Action

Experience dense controls combining jumps, dodges, attacks, and timing-based gimmicks.

A Blend of Puzzles and Exploration

Analyze twisted spaces and find your way to continue the journey to activate the gates.

Intensely Atmospheric Stages

Distinct areas such as silent forests, lifeless ruins, and geometrically distorted spaces convey unique emotions.

A World Opened by the Power of Music

Play while listening to a beautiful soundtrack. Gather singing stars to activate closed gates and restart the halted flow.

A Narrative Conveyed Through Symbols

Rather than direct explanations, the story is told through atmosphere, direction, space, and emotion.
short_desc: To heal a corrupted and crumbling world, Nia's journey begins. Beyond the twisted space, restore the gates and reclaim the forgotten flow.
